acceptance_tests.name: pilot_validators_green
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the command exits 0 AND prints its named PASS line (e.g. 'CURRICULUM L1L6 VALIDATION PASS'); any FAIL line is a packet failure regardless of exit code

adversarial.expectation: the adversarial fixture (a word whose initial م IS a root letter) must stay correctly classified; if the procedure misowns it, the packet verdict is repair, not accept

positive.expectation: the pilot's مسجد analysis (root س ج د, pattern-owned م) survives review as a correct candidate

commands.purpose: verify the pilot parity invariant (facts == segmentation == hover letters)

commands.expect: overlap table with zero unexplained conflicts
commands.purpose: cross-check the candidate procedure against sarf@2.4 candidate rows for overlap/conflict
commands.run: python - (inline: join pilot procedure rule keys against qamus/skills/rule-registry-increment-24.jsonl ids; emit overlap table)

defeaters: a produced row conflicts with a repo-certified fact -> record as contradicted, do not overwrite
the private corpus is unavailable -> metadata-only steps proceed; body-reading steps abort cleanly

conditions: procedure conflicts with an accepted sarf rule
any fixture requires a linguistic ruling beyond the evidence
escalation_trigger.route: Sol integration review -> owner adjudication where a rule/status change is implied

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: never invent an example, answer key or analysis the source or an independent authority does not support; abstain and record the gap
evidence_policy.statement: evidence level: curriculum-source-supported (uncertified); every row cites its claim-ledger claim_id and manifest file_id (source + claim identity); lesson prose is read in private custody and never committed; committed rows are original restatements

expected_outputs.description: review bundle: procedure text, fixture results, overlap table, recommendation (accept-as-candidate / repair / reject)

guards: the METHOD transfers, linguistic conclusions never do: a lesson-derived pattern licenses a candidate row, never a resolved analysis at any occurrence
rival-analysis handling: any item admitting more than one admissible analysis is recorded with ALL alternatives (analysis-dependent / school-dependent), never side-picked
no candidate-to-certified automatic promotion: nothing this packet produces may carry status certified; only tools/certify_typed_fact.py certifies, after review, outside this packet

non_deployment.statement: All outputs are candidate-plane repo artifacts; no live surface, entry store, or public payload is touched; deployment is owner-gated elsewhere.

out_of_scope: editing sarf/SKILL.md or any rule registry directly
scope.summary: Adjudicate curriculum/l1l6/pilot/: the candidate root-vs-pattern-vs-affix letter-ownership procedure, its fixtures and its segmentation/hover parity proof. If accepted, Sol integrates a sarf@2.x candidate increment through the NORMAL rule-registry path; this packet itself only prepares the review bundle.

title: Review and (if approved) promote the pilot letter-ownership candidate procedure into the sarf skill plane
tools_required: the PRIVATE lesson corpus (owner custody) for any step that reads lesson bodies; metadata-only steps run from committed artifacts
